module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that automatically records mission replays (.rpl files). It applies the storage limits chosen in the settings (by count or by maximum size), creates a .rplMeta.json file with the mission id, time, career context and attempt, and manages the camera while a mission replay plays.
notes: Settings read: enableMissionReplayCapModes ('maxSize' or 'count'), countReplayCapMode, maxSizeReplayCapMode (in MB).
Hooks listened to: onReplayStateChanged, onReplayRecordingValueRequested, onMissionAutoReplayRecordingSettingChanged, onMissionAttemptAggregated.

deleteByCount loops up to diff + 1: it therefore deletes one more file than the excess (to make room for the new recording); the index can exceed #files if diff + 1 > #files, which would call FS:removeFile(nil).
The file tables are sorted by creation date (FS:stat(file).createtime), from oldest to newest.
originalCamMode, originalPathId, originalPathLoop and lastFrameState are file-local variables.

init.desc: Called when the module is created: replayRecording = false, currentReplayFile = nil.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: stops the current recording and the AI replay (aiRecording module).

executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts: reads the mission replays folder (core_replay.getMissionReplaysPath).

getMissionReplayFiles.desc: Lists the *.rpl files in the mission replays folder, from oldest to newest.

deleteByCount.desc: Deletes the oldest replays when their number exceeds the countReplayCapMode setting.

deleteByMaxSize.desc: Deletes the oldest replays while the total size (in MB) reaches maxSizeReplayCapMode.

deleteOlderReplays.desc: Applies the cleanup rule chosen in the enableMissionReplayCapModes setting ('maxSize' or 'count').

stopIfRec.desc: Stops the replay recording if it is in progress (core_replay.toggleMissionRecording).

startNewRec.desc: Stops any recording, cleans up old replays, then starts a new recording if the replayRecording setting is active and the replay is inactive. Stores the file in currentReplayFile.

buildMetaInfo.desc: Writes the <replay>.rplMeta.json file (missionId, missionName, time, humanTime, career context, and attempt if provided). Does nothing without currentReplayFile.

saveMetaInfoWithoutAttempt.desc: Writes the metadata without an attempt then forgets the current file.

onMissionAttemptAggregated.desc: Hook called when a mission attempt is aggregated: writes the metadata with the attempt then forgets the current file.

onReplayRecordingValueRequested.desc: Hook called when the UI requests the automatic recording state: replies with guihooks.trigger('onReplayRecordingValueRequested', replayRecording).

onMissionAutoReplayRecordingSettingChang.desc: Hook called when the automatic recording setting changes.

missionPlaybackStarted.desc: At the start of a mission replay playback: stores the camera (and the path if camera is 'path'), switches to orbit camera, then restarts the simulation after 0.1 s.

missionPlaybackEnded.desc: At the end of playback: restores the original camera path or the original camera.

onReplayStateChanged.desc: Hook called on every replay state change. Detects the start and end of playback of a replay belonging to the current mission and calls missionPlaybackStarted / missionPlaybackEnded.
